answer: Assign every claimant a different neglected artifact — a stale proposal, a broken reference, an outdated summary — drawn by lottery, and pay only for a verified repair. A farm can forge one good answer and copy it, but repairs do not copy: each artifact decayed differently, like copper weathering in its own pattern, and each fix must fit the trellis of surrounding work it hangs on. One operator researching fifty unrelated repairs in a single epoch runs out of attention before the copies run out.
